novel_features.name: Launch Momentum Tracker
novel_features.description: See live vote and comment deltas for any post since your last check — no browser required on launch day.
novel_features.rationale: Requires diffing a live GraphQL query against a SQLite snapshot; no existing PH tool has a named momentum command.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this to track launch-day rank changes or monitor a competitor's post in real time without polling a browser.

novel_features.name: Competitor Audit
novel_features.description: Get every recent launch in a topic ranked by votes, with maker overlap detection across top posts.
novel_features.rationale: Requires joining live API results with the synced maker table; no existing CLI exposes this as a named command.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use before launching to understand competitive density and identify which makers dominate your category.

novel_features.name: Daily Digest
novel_features.description: Structured summary of yesterday's or today's top launches per topic — works offline after sync.
novel_features.rationale: Requires time-windowed aggregation from the local store; the output shape is designed for LLM pipelines.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use in morning briefing scripts or LLM pipelines to get a structured feed of top launches without hitting rate limits.

novel_features.name: Watchlist
novel_features.description: Pin any posts (yours, competitors), then batch-refresh all of them at once to see current stats and deltas.
novel_features.rationale: Requires local JSON state for the pinned list plus GraphQL queries for each; no existing PH CLI has a named watchlist.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use to track your own launch and a handful of competitors without opening the browser.

novel_features.name: Topic Subscription Inbox
novel_features.description: See only posts that are new since you last checked for each subscribed topic — cursor-based, never re-shows seen launches.
novel_features.rationale: Requires storing a per-topic last-seen cursor locally and querying the API for posts newer than that cursor.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use for competitive monitoring workflows where you want exactly the delta since last run, not a full topic dump.

novel_features.name: Topic Velocity
novel_features.description: Week-over-week post count and average vote delta for a topic — is your category heating up or cooling down?
novel_features.rationale: Requires time-windowed aggregation grouped by week from the synced store; not computable from a single API call.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use to decide whether a category is worth entering or to track how competitive dynamics are shifting over time.

novel_features.name: Post Vote-Rate
novel_features.description: Rank posts by votes-per-day-since-launch instead of raw vote totals — surfaces underrated recent launches.
novel_features.rationale: Requires computing votes ÷ days-since-launch for each synced post; raw-votes ranking buries recent products under old ones.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use to find products with strong launch momentum that raw vote leaderboards don't surface.

novel_features.name: Trending Topics
novel_features.description: Which topics have the fastest-growing post count and vote volume this week versus last week?
novel_features.rationale: Requires comparing this week vs prior week grouped by topic from the synced store; a single API call cannot return this.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use to identify emerging categories before they peak, or to find where to launch for maximum visibility.

novel_features.name: Cross-Topic Post Finder
novel_features.description: Find posts that appear in multiple specified topics simultaneously — 'AI tools that are also productivity tools'.
novel_features.rationale: Requires a SQLite JOIN on the post_topics table across multiple topic slugs; not a trivial query for non-SQL users.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use to find products in your exact market niche where multiple category labels intersect.

novel_features.name: Maker Portfolio Summary
novel_features.description: Aggregate stats across a maker's full product history: total votes, avg per launch, best launch, days since last launch.
novel_features.rationale: Requires fetching all user posts from the API and aggregating across them; no existing CLI surfaces these combined stats.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use to research prolific makers before collaborating, or track your own cumulative launch impact.

narrative.headline: Every Product Hunt feature, plus launch-day momentum tracking, offline search, and a local database no other Product Hunt tool has.
narrative.value_prop: product-hunt-pp-cli syncs launches, topics, and makers to a local SQLite store so you can query them offline, track vote momentum in real time, and pipe structured JSON into your own scripts. Whether you're researching a launch, monitoring a topic, or building a daily briefing, this CLI gives you PH data without the browser.
narrative.auth_narrative: Get a free developer token from your Product Hunt API Dashboard (producthunt.com → Settings → API Dashboard → Create Application → Developer Token). Set PRODUCT_HUNT_TOKEN in your environment. The token never expires.

quickstart.comment: Sync the last 7 days of launches to your local store
See today's top launches as structured JSON
Structured briefing of yesterday's developer-tools launches

quickstart.command: product-hunt-pp-cli watchlist add ray-so && product-hunt-pp-cli watchlist refresh
quickstart.comment: Track a post and see its current stats

troubleshoots.fix: Run `product-hunt-pp-cli auth set-token <token>` with your developer token from the PH API Dashboard
The API allows ~60 req/min. Use `sync` once, then rely on offline commands (`digest`, `topics velocity`, `posts vote-rate`)
Run `product-hunt-pp-cli sync --since 30d` first to populate the local store
This only affects unauthenticated access. A valid PRODUCT_HUNT_TOKEN bypasses the challenge

narrative.when_to_use: Use product-hunt-pp-cli when you need structured Product Hunt data in scripts, LLM pipelines, or CI workflows. Best for founders tracking launch-day momentum, developers monitoring topic velocity, and agents running daily briefings. Prefer this over manual PH browsing for any repeatable data workflow.

recipes.title: Morning launch briefing
recipes.command: product-hunt-pp-cli digest developer-tools --yesterday --json | jq '.posts[] | {name, votes: .votesCount, tagline}'
recipes.explanation: Get yesterday's developer-tools launches as a structured JSON feed for your morning script or LLM pipeline

recipes.title: Track your own launch
recipes.command: product-hunt-pp-cli watchlist add my-product-slug && product-hunt-pp-cli posts momentum my-product-slug
recipes.explanation: Pin your launch and see live vote+comment deltas since your last check

recipes.title: Pre-launch competitive audit
recipes.explanation: Get every recent launch in developer-tools ranked by votes with maker overlap — use --select to narrow the response for agents

recipes.title: Topic trend analysis
recipes.explanation: See week-over-week post count and avg vote delta to understand whether your target category is heating up

recipes.title: New-only topic feed
recipes.command: product-hunt-pp-cli topics subscribe developer-tools && product-hunt-pp-cli topics inbox --json
recipes.explanation: Subscribe to a topic and see only posts you haven't seen yet — advances the cursor so next run shows only newer launches

trigger_phrases: what launched on Product Hunt today
which topics are trending on Product Hunt
